instructions: Which banking support intent does the customer_message express? Pick the single best match.

descriptions.Refund_not_showing_up: The customer requested or was promised a refund, but it has not appeared in their account yet
descriptions.activate_my_card: The customer wants to activate a new card or asks how to activate it
descriptions.age_limit: The customer asks about the minimum age to open or use an account
descriptions.apple_pay_or_google_pay: The customer asks about adding the card to Apple Pay or Google Pay, or problems using them
descriptions.atm_support: The customer asks which ATMs they can use or where to find an ATM that accepts the card
descriptions.automatic_top_up: The customer asks about setting up, changing or using automatic top-ups
descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer made or received a bank transfer but the account balance has not updated
descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: The customer deposited a cheque or cash but the account balance has not updated
descriptions.beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer cannot add a payee or beneficiary, or a transfer to a beneficiary is not allowed
descriptions.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made
descriptions.card_about_to_expire: The customer's card is expiring soon and they ask about a replacement

descriptions.card_arrival: The customer ordered a card and it has not arrived yet, or asks to track its delivery
descriptions.card_delivery_estimate: The customer asks how long card delivery takes or when a new card will arrive
descriptions.card_linking: The customer wants to link or connect an existing card to the app or account
descriptions.card_not_working: The customer's physical card is not working
descriptions.card_payment_fee_charged: The customer was charged a fee for a card payment and asks why
descriptions.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a card payment they do not recognise

descriptions.cash_withdrawal_charge: The customer was charged a fee for withdrawing cash and asks why

descriptions.change_pin: The customer wants to change or reset their card PIN
descriptions.compromised_card: The customer thinks their card details were stolen or used fraudulently while they still have the card
descriptions.contactless_not_working: Contactless (tap to pay) payments are not working

descriptions.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined
descriptions.declined_transfer: A bank transfer the customer tried to make was declined
descriptions.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a direct debit payment they do not recognise

descriptions.edit_personal_details: The customer wants to change personal details such as name, address or phone number
descriptions.exchange_charge: The customer asks about fees charged for exchanging currency
descriptions.exchange_rate: The customer asks what exchange rate is used or where to see current rates
descriptions.exchange_via_app: The customer wants to exchange money between currencies using the app
descriptions.extra_charge_on_statement: The customer sees an unexpected extra fee or charge on their statement
descriptions.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through
descriptions.fiat_currency_support: The customer asks which fiat currencies they can hold or exchange
descriptions.get_disposable_virtual_card: The customer wants to create or get a disposable (single-use) virtual card
descriptions.get_physical_card: The customer asks how to get their physical card
descriptions.getting_spare_card: The customer wants an additional or spare card
descriptions.getting_virtual_card: The customer wants a virtual card or asks how to get one
descriptions.lost_or_stolen_card: The customer lost their card or it was stolen

descriptions.passcode_forgotten: The customer forgot their app passcode or password and cannot log in

descriptions.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending and has not completed
descriptions.pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked, for example after too many wrong attempts

descriptions.request_refund: The customer wants to request a refund for a purchase
descriptions.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted or returned to the account, and the customer asks why

descriptions.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or cancelled after it appeared to succeed
